what.text: Sri Lankan refugees moved from Sri Lanka to India.
UNHCR reported 200000 refugees in India in 1990 and 89507 in 2025.
In 2025, India hosted 60.3 percent of all Sri Lankan refugees.

why.text: Anti-Tamil violence occurred across Sri Lanka in July 1983.
Sri Lanka experienced armed conflict involving the Government of Sri Lanka against the LTTE, EPRLF, TELO, and the JVP.
The Sri Lankan army defeated the LTTE in May 2009, ending the conflict.

when.text: Large-scale flight to India began in July 1983, followed by a wave of arrivals from 1990 to 1994.
The recorded refugee population stood at 200000 in 1990 and 1991, then decreased to 50730 in 2005.
The refugee population was recorded at 69609 in 2006, 93259 in 2020, and 89507 in 2025.

how.text: Tamils crossed the Palk Strait to Tamil Nadu.
In 2016, the Government of India reported 64144 refugees in government camps and 36861 registered refugees outside camps.
UNHCR recorded 63162 refugees in India in 2016.
